shots.caption: The printer
shots.alt: The Inspector's device pane for the simulated Klipper 3D printer, paused, with its temperatures and extruder_target limited to 0 °C to 260 °C

shots.caption: The camera frame
shots.alt: The Inspector's camera pane with the latest demo frame, a line drawing of the print knocked over on the bed, image/jpeg, 640 × 480, 24 KB

shots.caption: The pending cancel
shots.alt: The Inspector's pending cancel. Because a cancelled print on the Klipper 3D printer can't be resumed, the hub holds the agent print-watcher's request to run cancel for a person, with the camera's frame beside the Approve and run cancel and Reject buttons

shots.caption: The message log
shots.alt: The Inspector's message log with hal/read results shown as image/jpeg 640 by 480 descriptions, the hal/write for a nozzle temperature of 300 °C blocked with error -32010 LIMIT_EXCEEDED, and the cancel left pending

shots.caption: Stopped
shots.alt: The Inspector's stop banner, which shows that every command is blocked with error -32014 STOPPED until a person lifts the stop with UNLOCK
